name: Cinematic Storytelling
about: Slower pacing, small clean captions, teal-and-orange colour, few elegant graphics, cinematic music if you have some.
about_tl: Mas mabagal, maliliit na malinis na caption, teal-orange na kulay, kaunting eleganteng graphics.
instruction: Let the story breathe: keep short pauses that add tension. Few zooms.
